sections.name: nearestDoor
sections.code: function nearestDoor(){if(pl.inside||pl.car)return null;let b=null,bd=3.6;for(const d of doors){const q=Math.hypot(d.x-pl.x,d.z-pl.z);if(q<bd){bd=q;b=d}}return b}

sections.name: nearestCar
sections.code: function nearestCar(maxD=4.6){let best=null,bd=maxD;for(const c of cars){if(c.dead)continue;const d=Math.hypot(c.x-pl.x,c.z-pl.z);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=c}}return best}
